comment: One set of number wording for metric values: `vonkctl metrics show` asserts every case below, and the Controller web charts follow the same rules (the web test joins this file in the first chart PR). Rules: tokens per second keep one decimal below 100, else whole; seconds read as whole ms below 1 s, else two decimals; watts, degrees, rpm and MHz are whole; watt-hours read as kWh (two decimals) from 1000; bytes use binary units with one decimal (B whole); percent and ratio read with one decimal and a percent sign (a ratio is x100); per-second rates and counts keep two decimals below 10, one below 100 and whole above, without trailing zeros; no value reads No data in this range.
